provenance.sequence_source: ColE1/pMB1 origin, common cloning-vector form: 100% identical to GenBank X03174 (cloning vector pEX2, 1986) and present in 140+ deposited vectors; the earliest occurrence found is X01803 (Nov 1985, a P-element transformation vector). Differs from the canonical pMB1 origin (pBR322 J01749 / pUC18 L08752) by 2 bp at positions 393-394 (1-based) in the RNA I/RNA II control region. Identified by date-bracketed BLAST vs NCBI nt (tools/blast.py): 142 perfect full-length carriers in 1985-1996. Re-delimited (2026-11) from a 792 bp fragment to pBR322 (J01749) 2534-3122, minus strand: the old fragment also carried 20 bp of backbone on the bla side and the 183 bp past the RNA-to-DNA transition (pBR322 2351-2533, carrying the L-strand primosome assembly site), which is not part of the origin as conventionally annotated.

functional_claims.label: High-copy ColE1/pMB1 origin; copy number set by the RNA I/RNA II antisense system.

source.quote: The ColE1/pMB1-family origin of replication: the 589 bp region from the RNA II promoter -35 to the DNA replication start, carrying the convergent RNA I / RNA II promoter pair that sets plasmid copy number.

functional_claims.label: Differs from the canonical pMB1 origin (pBR322/pUC) by 2 bp at positions 393-394 (1-based) in the RNA I/RNA II control region; a long-established, benign cloning-vector form present in 140+ deposited vectors since 1985, so the difference does not impair replication.

source.quote: 100% identity to GenBank X03174 (cloning vector pEX2, 1986) and 142 pre-1997 deposited vectors; earliest X01803 (Nov 1985)

functional_claims.label: Spans pBR322 2534-3122 (minus strand): from the RNA II promoter -35 to the RNA-to-DNA transition. The part ends at pBR322 2534, inside the run of five A residues where the primer RNA turns into DNA, one base before the three consecutive nucleotides (dA, dA, dC; pBR322 2533-2531) at which DNA synthesis starts. The ColE1 deposit J01566 marks this start at its base 1197 (+/- 1), = pBR322 2532; J01749's uncited rep_origin at 2535 is 2 bp upstream.

value.end: RNA-to-DNA transition: the base before the DNA start nucleotides (pBR322 2533-2531)

source.quote: The site is one of three consecutive nucleotides, dA, dA, and dC, located at a unique position. ... The transition from the primer RNA to DNA occurs in a region consisting of a segment of five A residues.

provenance.from: pairwise alignment to GenBank J01749 and J01566 (rep_origin 1197) + PMID 325558 and 6156450 abstracts
